exercises.name: Barbell Bench Press
exercises.instructions: Lie on bench, grip bar slightly wider than shoulders. Lower to chest, press up explosively. Keep feet flat, back arched naturally.

exercises.name: Barbell Back Squat
exercises.instructions: Bar on upper back, feet shoulder-width. Descend until thighs parallel, drive through heels. Keep chest up, knees tracking over toes.

exercises.name: Barbell Deadlift
exercises.instructions: Feet hip-width, grip outside legs. Hinge at hips, keep back flat. Drive through floor, extend hips and knees simultaneously.

exercises.name: Barbell Bent Over Row
exercises.instructions: Hinge forward 45°, grip shoulder-width. Pull bar to lower chest, squeeze shoulder blades. Control descent.

exercises.name: Barbell Overhead Press
exercises.instructions: Bar at shoulder height, grip slightly wider than shoulders. Press overhead until arms locked. Keep core tight, avoid leaning back.

exercises.name: Pull-Up
exercises.instructions: Hang with overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulders. Pull until chin over bar. Control descent.

exercises.name: Chin-Up
exercises.instructions: Underhand grip, shoulder-width. Pull until chin over bar. Emphasizes biceps more than pull-ups.

exercises.name: Parallel Bar Dips
exercises.instructions: Support body on parallel bars. Lower until shoulders below elbows. Press back up. Lean forward for chest, upright for triceps.

exercises.name: Push-Up
exercises.instructions: Hands shoulder-width, body straight. Lower until chest near floor. Press back up. Keep core engaged.

exercises.name: Bodyweight Squat
exercises.instructions: Feet shoulder-width, arms forward for balance. Descend until thighs parallel. Drive through heels.

exercises.name: Walking Lunge
exercises.instructions: Step forward, lower back knee near ground. Front thigh parallel. Push off, alternate legs.

exercises.name: Plank
exercises.instructions: Forearms on ground, body straight line. Hold position, engage core. Don't let hips sag.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Bench Press
exercises.instructions: Lie on bench, dumbbells at chest level. Press up until arms extended. Control descent, keep wrists straight.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Shoulder Press
exercises.instructions: Seated or standing, dumbbells at shoulder height. Press overhead until arms extended. Lower with control.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Row
exercises.instructions: Support one hand on bench, row dumbbell to hip. Squeeze shoulder blade. Keep back flat.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Bicep Curl
exercises.instructions: Standing, arms at sides. Curl dumbbells to shoulders, supinate wrists. Control descent. Don't swing.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Overhead Tricep Extension
exercises.instructions: Hold dumbbell overhead with both hands. Lower behind head, extend back up. Keep elbows close.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise
exercises.instructions: Arms at sides, slight elbow bend. Raise dumbbells to shoulder height. Control descent. Don't swing.

exercises.name: Goblet Squat
exercises.instructions: Hold dumbbell at chest. Squat deep, elbows between knees. Drive through heels.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift
exercises.instructions: Dumbbells at thighs, slight knee bend. Hinge at hips, lower weights along legs. Feel hamstring stretch.

exercises.name: Leg Press
exercises.instructions: Feet shoulder-width on platform. Lower until knees 90°. Press through heels, don't lock knees.

exercises.name: Leg Curl
exercises.instructions: Lie face down, pad behind ankles. Curl heels to glutes. Control descent.

exercises.name: Leg Extension
exercises.instructions: Seated, pad on shins. Extend legs until straight. Control descent. Don't lock knees.

exercises.name: Lat Pulldown
exercises.instructions: Wide grip on bar. Pull to upper chest, lean back slightly. Squeeze shoulder blades. Control ascent.

exercises.name: Seated Cable Row
exercises.instructions: Seated, feet on platform. Pull handle to abdomen. Squeeze shoulder blades. Keep back straight.

exercises.name: Cable Chest Fly
exercises.instructions: Cables at shoulder height, step forward. Bring handles together in front. Control return.

exercises.name: Cable Tricep Pushdown
exercises.instructions: High pulley, rope or bar. Push down until arms straight. Control return. Keep elbows tucked.

exercises.name: Cable Bicep Curl
exercises.instructions: Low pulley, bar attachment. Curl to shoulders. Control descent. Constant tension.

exercises.name: Face Pull
exercises.instructions: High pulley, rope attachment. Pull to face, externally rotate shoulders. Squeeze rear delts.

exercises.name: Incline Barbell Bench Press
exercises.instructions: Bench at 30-45°. Lower bar to upper chest. Press up. Emphasizes upper chest.

exercises.name: Decline Barbell Bench Press
exercises.instructions: Bench declined 15-30°. Lower bar to lower chest. Press up. Emphasizes lower chest.

exercises.name: Front Squat
exercises.instructions: Bar on front shoulders, elbows high. Squat deep, chest up. More quad emphasis than back squat.

exercises.name: Sumo Deadlift
exercises.instructions: Wide stance, toes out, grip inside legs. Pull, drive knees out. More glute emphasis.

exercises.name: Bulgarian Split Squat
exercises.instructions: Rear foot elevated on bench. Lower until front thigh parallel. Drive through front heel.

exercises.name: Barbell Hip Thrust
exercises.instructions: Upper back on bench, bar across hips. Drive hips up, squeeze glutes at top. Lower with control.

exercises.name: Hanging Leg Raise
exercises.instructions: Hang from bar. Raise legs to 90° or higher. Control descent. Don't swing.

exercises.name: Ab Wheel Rollout
exercises.instructions: Knees on ground, hold wheel. Roll forward, maintain plank. Pull back with abs.

exercises.name: Russian Twist
exercises.instructions: Seated, lean back 45°, feet elevated. Twist torso side to side. Keep core engaged.

exercises.name: Mountain Climbers
exercises.instructions: Plank position. Alternate driving knees to chest rapidly. Keep hips low.

exercises.name: Burpee
exercises.instructions: Squat, hands down, jump back to plank. Push-up optional. Jump feet forward, jump up.

exercises.name: Box Jump
exercises.instructions: Stand facing box. Jump explosively, land softly. Step down. Develop power.

exercises.name: Battle Ropes
exercises.instructions: Hold rope ends, create waves. Alternate or simultaneous. High intensity conditioning.

exercises.name: Farmer's Walk
exercises.instructions: Heavy dumbbells at sides. Walk forward, maintain posture. Core engaged, shoulders back.

exercises.name: Barbell Curl
exercises.instructions: Underhand grip, shoulder-width. Curl to shoulders. Control descent. Don't swing.

exercises.name: Skull Crusher
exercises.instructions: Lie on bench, bar overhead. Lower to forehead by bending elbows. Extend back up.

exercises.name: Hammer Curl
exercises.instructions: Neutral grip (palms facing). Curl to shoulders. Emphasizes brachialis and forearms.

exercises.name: Preacher Curl
exercises.instructions: Arms on preacher pad. Curl to shoulders. Isolates biceps, prevents cheating.

exercises.name: Concentration Curl
exercises.instructions: Seated, elbow braced on inner thigh. Curl to shoulder. Maximum bicep isolation.

exercises.name: Close Grip Bench Press
exercises.instructions: Narrow grip. Lower to chest. Press up. Tricep emphasis.

exercises.name: Cable Crossover
exercises.instructions: High cables, step forward. Bring handles together in arc. Control return.

exercises.name: Pec Deck Fly
exercises.instructions: Seated, arms on pads. Bring pads together. Control return. Isolates chest.
